recommendation: Keep this source fix as-is. It corrects implementer-visible validation text without changing invariant behavior; any broader cross-resource search enhancement for Encounter-derived metadata should be handled as a separate work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-32580 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for the R5 request to drop DocumentReference.facilityType and DocumentReference.practiceSetting. The final OO decision kept both elements, added warning invariants so Encounter context is not used alongside facilityType and/or practiceSetting, and considered search support for both mechanisms if possible.
initial_application: Git 699aab03f786df039dafae1781e7e79d05746538 added docRef-1 and docRef-2 warning invariants to DocumentReference. Git c3e4b3cd829b31ddad2570de39731870182d7597 refined both expressions to test only Encounter context, and git 55512f8e09be7228efab289f8bf660242d29654d later attached the invariant conditions to context, facilityType, and practiceSetting. The direct context, facility, and setting search parameters are present in current source.
additional_context: DocumentReference is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. Current DocumentReference.context can reference Appointment, Encounter, or EpisodeOfCare, so docRef-2's old human text saying practiceSetting is allowed only when context is not present was broader than both the approved Encounter-specific rule and the current expression. OO minutes from 2022-08-09 confirm the accepted disposition to keep the elements and add an invariant; no directly relevant conflicting Zulip discussion was found.
reconciliation: Changed only source/documentreference/structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml so docRef-2 says "practiceSetting SHALL only be present if context is not an encounter". The invariant expression and search parameter definitions were left unchanged.
source_changes: source/documentreference/structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml: aligned docRef-2 human-readable warning text with the Encounter-specific FHIRPath expression and the parallel docRef-1 wording.
